events.title: Woodstock '69 Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Rewind to 1969! On this day, the iconic Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that changed everything. Which legendary performance is still in your head?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we pay tribute to the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1 or 3, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From that legendary cover to every track, it's pure genius. What's your go-to song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, a true rock icon. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music Player Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: 007 Celebration
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to celebrate the iconic spy. What's your favourite Bond film and, more importantly, who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on. What's your most cherished Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true master of comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Queen Legend Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
